title: Add CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_RESET for session reuse
description: Currently each crypto operation requires open()/close() of the fd. For high-frequency workloads (HMAC per packet, CBC per block device request) this is expensive: open() triggers LSM hooks, allocates kernel state, takes locks. Add CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_RESET that re-arms a finalized OPERATION fd for a new operation with the same algo and key binding. The IV must be set again for cipher sessions after reset. Providers that cannot cheaply reset return -EOPNOTSUPP.
